title: Profile runtime variants and stored credentials
description: Capability profile-runtime-variants (r265, docs/development/r265-profile-variants.md); r266 kimi-runtime-profiles adds runtime kimi, Kimi-kind profiles (kimiAccount) and credential.kimiAccountId (docs/development/r266-kimi-profiles.md). A profile = provider + one credential + runtime variants. Profile items of GET /v2/profiles, GET|PATCH /v2/profiles/{p} and the variant routes carry profileRuntimeFields next to the legacy fields (cliKind/source/options.dsh stay the compatibility projection of the primary variant). Keys are write-only: no response, event, log, error or export contains a key.

kind.description: openaiCompatible | deepseekNative | anthropicCompatible | chatgptLogin | claudeSubscription | kimiNative | kimiAccount (open set).

credential.description: Never the value. present: stored key file / auth key exists, env variable set on the host now, ChatGPT login present; null for Claude subscription accounts (use /v2/claude/accounts status).

source.description: stored | env | chatgptLogin | claudeAccount | kimiAccount | none (open set).

kimiAccountId.description: r266 additive: the Kimi account of a Kimi-kind profile (source kimiAccount; present = the account has usable OAuth credentials now, see /v2/kimi/accounts); null otherwise.

version.description: Stored keys: increments on each write; a write applies to runtimes started afterwards.

primary.description: The profile's own runtime (cliKind); never removable; its defaults are the profile's model settings.

inUse.description: Non-retired sessions bound to this variant (primary: plus pre-r265 sessions of the profile).

models.description: Additive (r265 integration). DSH variants: the models DSH's pinned catalog offers new agents (clients must not hard-code them; a running agent's live list is its model/list). r266: kimi variants of Kimi-kind profiles: the Kimi account's provisioned catalog (empty before the first login). null for other runtimes: use GET /v2/profiles/{p}/models.

reason.description: chatgptLoginCodexOnly | claudeCredentialClaudeOnly | providerNotDeepseekNative | anthropicRouteRequired | anthropicRouteNotYetSupported | dshProfileCodexVariantNotYetSupported | providerNotKimiNative | kimiAccountKimiOnly | componentNotInstalled | platformUnsupported (open set).

kimiAccount.description: r266 additive: Kimi-kind profiles (cliKind kimi): the Kimi account id new agents run on; null otherwise.

variantCreate.description: POST /v2/profiles/{p}/variants. r265: runtime dsh on a DeepSeek API-key profile; r266: runtime kimi on a Kimi / Moonshot API-key profile. Any base URL, relays included (profile-relay-runtimes: the provider decides, never the host). Kimi efforts: off | low | medium | high | max.

baseUrl.description: profile-relay-runtimes (additive): runtime dsh only, the DSH (DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible) address, stored as the profile's interfaceBaseUrls.deepseekNative. Required (409 variant_base_url_missing) when the profile's main address is a relay and no DSH address is set.

variantPatch.description: PATCH /v2/profiles/{p}/variants/{v}; null restores the default. On the primary = PATCH /v2/profiles/{p} model/modelReasoningEffort.

baseUrl.description: profile-relay-runtimes (additive): a DSH variant's address (= PATCH /v2/profiles/{p} interfaceBaseUrls.deepseekNative); null restores the official default. 400 for other runtimes (they use the profile's base URL).

profileCredentialPatch.description: Additive PATCH /v2/profiles/{p} fields. apiKey (DSH and Codex API-key profiles): write-only string; null clears a DSH stored key. credential: DSH only, env needs an explicit envName (no fallback). POST /v2/profiles kind dsh also accepts apiKey and credential.

newAgentVariant.description: Additive POST /v2/human/agents and POST /v2/human/sessions field. Absent = the profile's defaultVariant. Errors (stage validation): 400 unknown_variant {profile, variantId, variants}, variant_runtime_unavailable {runtime, status, reason}, credential_missing.

launchBinding.description: Session resource launchBinding: frozen at creation, never re-resolved; no secret. Absent on sessions created before r265.
